verdict.rationale: Canva does ship an official CLI, but it is scoped narrowly to creating and managing Canva Apps (the Apps SDK), not a general-purpose CLI for AI-native workflows like design generation, export, or automation via Connect APIs — those are exposed via APIs/MCP, not the CLI. missing for 10: evidence of CLI supporting broader AI-native tasks (design generation, bulk export, Connect API operations), independent/hands-on usage reports.
